title: Logos 7 opening: against unwilling-or-by-will dilemmas
english: Seventh discourse. Against those who pose: “Did he beget the Son unwillingly or by will?”
The dilemma is rejected as a trap. The Father’s will is not a third thing between Father and Son that makes the Son later or lesser.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
After Logos I rem; earliest-forward Logos 7.
